subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The doc renderer (same runtime) is invoked in-runtime from the footprint; the plan renderer is the Go binary's render verb, resolved in order: an installed release binary (the release/resolver surface, per the repo-layout design) → source mode (`go run` when a Go toolchain and the source tree are present) → **degrade** (PRD UB-2): the plan entry stays in the catalog with its metadata and a named remedy replacing the page. Degradation is per-document and loud (a defect card), never a blank page or a dead server. The same probe-and-degrade posture covers missing renderer dependencies (the review runtime's proven pattern).
